Legal.privacy_body:
We take the protection of your personal data very seriously. We treat your personal data confidentially and in accordance with the statutory data protection regulations (in particular the General Data Protection Regulation, GDPR) and this privacy policy.

1. Controller

The controller within the meaning of the GDPR is the person named in the Legal Notice.

2. Creating an invoice without an account

If you create an invoice without signing in, the invoice data you enter or upload (customer and item data) is processed exclusively in memory and is not stored permanently. After the PDF/XML file is generated, this data is immediately discarded.

3. Account and invoicing-profile data

If you create an account, we process: your email address and a hashed password (or, if you sign in with Google, the profile data provided by Google); the company data you enter for your invoices (company name, address, VAT ID, IBAN/BIC/bank name, logo, brand color); customer and catalog data you save for reuse; an API key you generate; and the timestamps of your acceptance of the terms, privacy policy and data processing agreement.

4. Signing in with Google

If you register via "Continue with Google", Google Ireland Limited processes the data required for sign-in as an independent controller. Google's own privacy policy additionally applies.

5. Payment processing

To process paid plans, we use Stripe as our payment service provider and processor. Stripe processes the data required for payment processing in accordance with Stripe's privacy policy.

6. Transactional emails

To send system emails (e.g. password-reset links), we use the email service provider Resend as a processor.

7. Hosting

This website and its database are hosted with a hosting/database provider within the EU/US, with whom a data processing agreement under Art. 28 GDPR is in place.

8. Cookies

We use only strictly necessary cookies, including to maintain your login session. We do not use tracking or analytics cookies. Your cookie choice is stored locally in your browser.

9. Legal bases for processing

We process personal data on the following legal bases: Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR (performance of the usage contract, e.g. account management, invoice generation, payment processing), Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR (legitimate interest, e.g. IT security, abuse prevention, API key management) and Art. 6(1)(a) GDPR (consent, e.g. optional sign-in with Google).

10. Retention period

We store account-related data (see item 3) for as long as your account exists. You can delete your account and all associated data at any time yourself in your account settings; afterwards the data is deleted without undue delay, unless statutory retention obligations apply. Invoice data processed without an account is discarded immediately after creation, as described in item 2.

11. Your rights

Under the GDPR you have the following rights: access (Art. 15), rectification (Art. 16), erasure (Art. 17), restriction of processing (Art. 18), data portability (Art. 20) and objection to processing (Art. 21). You can obtain a copy of your data at any time via "Export data" and delete your account via "Delete account" in your account settings. For any other requests, please contact us via the email address given in the Legal Notice.

12. Right to lodge a complaint

You have the right to lodge a complaint with a data protection supervisory authority. As a provider based in Portugal, the competent supervisory authority is the Comissão Nacional de Proteção de Dados (CNPD), www.cnpd.pt. You may alternatively contact the supervisory authority of your habitual residence.
Legal.avv_body:
This agreement regulates the rights and obligations of the parties in connection with the processing of personal data in accordance with Art. 28 of the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR).

1. Subject of the Agreement

The contractor processes personal data on behalf of the client. This includes the conversion of provided invoice data into standardized formats (XRechnung, ZUGFeRD).

2. Duration of the Agreement

The contract is concluded for an indefinite period and can be terminated by either party with a notice period of 30 days.
Legal.accessibility_body:
We are committed to making eu-invoice.app accessible in line with Directive (EU) 2019/882 (the European Accessibility Act) and the Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2.1, conformance level AA.

Conformance status

This website has not yet undergone a formal accessibility audit by an external body. We work on it continuously: form fields have associated labels, interactive icon-only buttons have descriptive ARIA labels, and the site is operable by keyboard.

Feedback and contact

If you encounter any accessibility barriers on this website, please contact us via the email address given in the Legal Notice. We aim to respond to feedback promptly.

Statement date

This statement was last updated in September 2026.
